entities.summary: ELTA is a Lithuanian news agency based in Vilnius, Lithuania. In a day, it receives about 5,000 news articles and produces about 300 articles in Lithuanian, with translations to English and Russian. ELTA cooperates with foreign news agencies such as Reuters, Associated Press, Deutsche Presse-Agentur, Polish Press Agency and others. ELTA is a news agency in Europe, established in 1920. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
